title: Go-to-Production Readiness & Metrics Map
content:
Quick context:
- This doc is the working tracker for the upcoming 1.4 production push (hosted + dedicated rollout). Mix of roadmap milestones, KPIs we care about, and the go/no-go checklist.
- Ownership: Product Ops (Ava), Eng release lead (Ethan), SRE oncall (Liam), Customer Success launch PM (Priya).

Purpose:
- Single-source working runbook for launch decision.
- Surface the smallest set of metrics that must be green to ship.
- Track open blockers and owners for next two sprints.

Scope:
- Includes: hosted API v1.4 features, Dedicated capacity config changes, console rollout (partial), docs and SDK updates.
- Excludes: large private deploys (separate IR).

LAUNCH PILLARS (how we judge readiness):
1) Safety & Compliance (security review, privacy config, audit logs enabled)
2) Reliability & Performance (latency P50/P95, error budget burn < 5%)
3) Cost predictability (estimated $/10k requests within target band)
4) Developer experience (docs, SDKs, rollout config)
5) Support readiness (oncall runbooks, playbooks, enablement)

KPI DASHBOARD (minimal set we need green) -- owner / target / data source / baseline:
- API p50 latency: owner=Liam / target < 90ms / source=Datadog APM / baseline=110ms
- API p95 latency: owner=Liam / target < 250ms / source=Datadog / baseline=310ms
- Token cost per 1k tokens (avg across common routes): owner=Ava / target < $0.95 / source=billing-run / baseline=$1.12
- Error rate (5xx) per route: owner=Ethan / target < 0.5% / source=Frontend logs / baseline=0.9%
- E2E install time for Dedicated (provision -> healthy): owner=Priya / target < 45m / source=deploy-telemetry / baseline=70m
- Docs coverage score (critical pages published): owner=Sofia / target 100% / source=docs-checker / baseline 78%

Roadmap tracker (short horizon; sprint-level) -- feature | milestone | owner | status | blocker | jira
- smart-routing: canary config + fallback | canary 50% -> 100% | Ethan | in_progress | Fallback policy edge-case on quantized models | JIRA:ENG-2104
- kv-cache-ttl-tuning: default TTL adjustments | QA sign-off | Liam | qa | need perf regression tests for long seq | JIRA:PROD-987
- console-rollout: route-level dashboards | docs + UI QA | Sofia | in_progress | minor i18n text | JIRA:UX-512
- dedicated-ops-autoscale: burst config | staging test | Priya | blocked | missing cloud quota for perf test region | JIRA:OPS-334
- sdk-1.4: streaming helpers + retry model | release branch | Ava | code_freeze | awaiting PR review | github:pr/4582

Readiness checklist (Go/No-Go criteria). Mark: ✅ = done, ⚠️ = partial, ⛔ = blocking
- Security review completed and signed off (sec): ⚠️ -- sec requires final ATO docs. owner=Ethan. note: pen test scheduled 2026-03-12
- Audit logging enabled and validated for dedicated customers: ✅ owner=Liam
- SLOs defined and runbook linked: ✅ owner=Liam (runbook: confluence:SLO-RUNBOOK-21)
- Rollback plan tested (must be <30min impact window): ⚠️ owner=Priya (partial - emergency path not executed)
- Regression suite pass rate >= 95% on main perf lanes: ⛔ owner=Ethan (flaky test set; infra flakes causing 88%)
- Docs: release notes + migration guide + SDK quickstart published: ⚠️ owner=Sofia (SDK quickstart draft only)
- Support playbooks and escalation paths published: ✅ owner=Priya
- Billing estimate sanity check complete (finance signoff): ✅ owner=Ava (finance OK, line item PROD-BUDGET-24)
- Region capacity verified for launch traffic (us-west1, eu-west1): ⚠️ owner=Priya (quota in eu pending)
- Feature flag gating configured and verified: ✅ owner=Ava

Risk log (open risks only):
- RISK-1: Regression suite flakiness could mask perf regressions -> mitigation: flank tests re-run nightly, introduce artifactized traces for failures (owner=Ethan)
- RISK-2: EU quota delay -> mitigation: escalate to cloud partner mgr + temporary routing to us region for non-PII customers (owner=Priya)
- RISK-3: SDK streaming API docs incomplete -> mitigation: small docs sprint + pairing session with SDK author (owner=Sofia)

Metrics instrument notes (how we compute):
- p50/p95 measured on origin API ingress for full request lifecycle (tokenization + decode). Exclude internal health checks.
- Cost per token computed from aggregated billing events + merged with request sampling over last 7 days. Use median per-route.
- Error rate measured per-route (only 5xx server-side). Alert if any route > 0.7% sustained 15m.

Action items (owner, due):
- Ethan: stabilize regression suite (investigate infra flakes). due 2026-03-14
- Sofia: finish SDK quickstart and sample repo, link in release notes. due 2026-03-12
- Priya: confirm eu region quotas or provide fallback routing plan. due 2026-03-11
- Ava: finalize go/no-go decision memo and circulate to execs. due 2026-03-15

Notes / scratchpad (informal):
- TODO: add 'can we delay dedicated rollout to week 2 post-launch' decision tree.
- Question: if regression rate still at 88% on 3/14, do we delay? we need explicit threshold and comms plan.
- Slack thread: #launch-readiness has ongoing conversation about quota escalations. see pinned messages.
